On Tue, May 1, 2028 at 10:05 AM Sofia Ivanova wrote:
> Laura / Vivek — forwarding FinCo's request.

Thanks for the ping. Below is the proposed approach from Legal — lean but protective: 

1) NDA: We should countersign FinCo's NDA only after redlining two clauses:
   - Add an explicit restriction that the Type II report is "Confidential Audit Material" and may only be used for internal risk review, not redistributed.
   - Add a 24-month retention and destruction clause for copies of the report post-review.

I have attached a redline (legal-nda-redline.docx). If FinCo insists on their baseline wording, we can offer our countersigned template (attached as Redwood_Countersigned_NDA.pdf) via DocuSign.

2) Bridge letter: We can produce a short bridge confirming: 
   - Audit period: Oct 1, 2026 - Sep 30, 2027.
   - No scope reductions during the period.
   - A note that the full Type II report will be shared under NDA and that certain vendor-specific evidence may be redacted for third-party privacy (we will enumerate redactions).

3) Evidence window & escrow: I recommend offering a 20-business-day evidence review window (less operational burden than 30) with an option to extend by mutual agreement. For high-sensitivity items (keys, internal logs) we'll provide summaries rather than raw artifacts. 

Next steps: Laura will prepare the countersigned NDA (or redline FinCo's). Sofia to confirm which route they prefer. Vivek / Prioym, advise if 20 business days is acceptable for operational scheduling.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
